lines.ref:
When you realize you've fallen in
love with studying since you started
using these methods.

shots.brief: setting up desk / opening laptop (ref: Desk setup at night: turning on desk lamp, opening laptop, placing papers.; tripod)
placing drink/mug on desk (ref: Placing a mug of tea and a water bottle on the desk.; tripod)
placing phone/clock timer on desk (ref: Placing a phone displaying a stopwatch timer on the desk.; tripod)
time-lapse working on laptop at desk at night (ref: Time-lapse of studying, reading papers, and watching online lecture on laptop at night with timer running.; tripod)
time-lapse taking notes and working on laptop (ref: Side angle time-lapse taking handwritten notes while watching video lecture on laptop during daytime.; tripod)
close time-lapse desk working by a window (ref: Close angle time-lapse facing window, showing notes, running timer, and laptop screen.; tripod)
working late on laptop time-lapse (ref: Evening shot time-lapse of taking notes and typing on laptop trackpad with timer showing over 4 hours.; tripod)

audit.notes: Easily recreated with any library clips showing working on a laptop, coding, studying, or sitting at a desk with coffee. The value of the post is entirely delivered through the hook and detailed caption text.
audit.summary: A time-lapse montage of desk study sessions with a running timer, paired with an aspirational hook directing viewers to study tips in the caption.
